text: The Patriots dominated the Raiders 45-17 in a dominant Week 5 performance at Gillette Stadium, with Drake Maye putting on a virtuoso display by accounting for five total touchdowns—four through the air and one on the ground—in what amounted to a methodical dismantling of Las Vegas. The victory came with notable cost to the roster, however, as running back TreVeyon Henderson exited with an ankle injury and left tackle Will Campbell suffered a knee injury, both failing to return, while wide receiver Mack Hollins was placed on injured reserve Saturday with a calf injury ahead of the game. On the positive side, defensive tackle Christian Barmore returned from a one-game shoulder absence to bolster the defense, and running back Rhamondre Stevenson remained active, providing depth in the backfield despite the loss of Henderson. The Patriots also honored legendary kicker Adam Vinatieri during a halftime ceremony celebrating his Pro Football Hall of Fame induction, and the team wore throwback uniforms for the occasion.
